Tooling priorities

Resumable long-run search, external calibration evaluation split by run or family, and incremental tests for older excluded modules. See the quality-scope inventory before building on a legacy module.

Available now

GB-001 includes a protocol, equal-budget baselines, a full reference, and independent recounting. Calibration reports held-out annotation metrics. Search budgets and sieve bounds are enforced. The Lean layer checks finite trajectory and prime-pair certificates.
